mathematics.reason: Maths interpreter: PASS. The statement defines the total muon neutrino flux at Earth as the sum of contributions from all three initial neutrino flavors oscillating into ν_μ, which is the standard coherent-incoherent sum used in neutrino oscillation phenomenology. The transcription-fidelity check confirmed the equation was faithfully extracted from the paper. No knowledge-audit or mechanical engine check was performed on the equation's correctness against canonical form, but the formula is conceptually straightforward and well-established: the total flux in a given flavor is the sum over all source flavors of (source flux × oscillation probability). The unweighted sum is appropriate when the oscillation probabilities are already folded into each flux term. No contrary signal was found in any evidence channel.
